verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (brand, product, badges, headline, copy, CTA, legal), but the product can is shrunk to a small thumbnail pushed into the top-right corner. The SUNSET SALE ribbon sits on top of the AWARD WINNING pill, the badge cluster is scattered, and the 'missing asset' placeholder crowds the legal line at the bottom right. B breaks the reading order by putting the CTA above the headline. Its three badges are shrunk until they can't be read, the logo is a tiny mark lost under an oversized can, the 'missing asset' box sits prominently at the top left, and the headline and body copy run almost to the canvas edges.
